title: Valuing Noise Pollution: Evidence from Flight Path Changes
abstract: On September 18, 2014, the Federal Aviation Administration implemented new arrival and departure paths to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport. Overnight, aircraft noise increased in some residential neighborhoods and decreased in others. These changes occurred with no advance warning. We leverage this shock to provide causal evidence on the value of noise pollution. Our hedonic design uses data on houses that were sold both before and after the shock to identify households’  willingness to pay—through housing prices—to reduce noise pollution. We find robust evidence that a one decibel increase in noise caused property values to decline by 1.2%.
abstract_zh: 2014年9月18日，美国联邦航空管理局对凤凰城天港国际机场实施了新的进场和离场航线。一夜之间，一些居民区的飞机噪声增加，而另一些地区则有所减少。这些变化事先没有任何预告。我们利用这一冲击，为噪声污染的价值提供因果证据。我们的享乐定价设计使用了在冲击前后均有成交的房屋数据，以识别家庭通过房价体现的、愿意为降低噪声污染而支付的意愿。我们发现了稳健的证据表明，噪声每增加一分贝，房产价值下降1.2%。

title: Tax Policy and the Heterogeneous Costs of Homeownership
Optimal Second-best Menu Design: Evidence from Residential Electricity Plans
venue: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: Utilities increasingly sell electricity using complex menus of time-constant and time-varying price schedules. We study how to design such a menu to maximize social welfare in a second best environment where the marginal private and external costs of generating electricity vary over time, institutional constraints prevent mandating time-varying pricing, and consumer behavior is distorted by frictions. We develop a model of plan choice, consumption, and intertemporal substitution with time-varying marginal social costs, and estimate it using administrative data from a large utility. We provide evidence of substantial intertemporal substitution in response to timevarying price incentives, and selection across plans based on multidimensional heterogeneity. While the current menu's time-varying plans substantially shift consumption from high-price to low-price hours, we find that they reduce social welfare. This loss is mitigated by information frictions. We show how to redesign the menu to simultaneously improve outcomes for consumers, the utility, and the environment.
abstract_zh: 公用事业公司越来越多地采用由时间不变和时间可变价格表组成的复杂菜单来销售电力。我们研究在次优环境下，如何设计此类菜单以使社会福利最大化：在该环境中，发电的边际私人成本和外部成本随时间变化，制度约束使得无法强制实施分时定价，且消费者行为受到摩擦的扭曲。我们建立了一个包含套餐选择、消费和跨期替代的模型，该模型具有随时间变化的边际社会成本，并利用一家大型公用事业公司的行政数据对其进行了估计。我们发现，消费者对分时价格激励存在显著的跨期替代，且基于多维异质性的套餐选择存在明显的选择效应。尽管现行菜单中的分时套餐大幅地将消费从高价时段转移到低价时段，但我们发现它们降低了社会福利。这一损失可由信息摩擦部分缓解。我们说明了如何重新设计菜单，以同时改善消费者、公用事业公司和环境的结果。

title: The Value of Statistical Life for Seniors

Hazed and Confused: The Effect of Air Pollution on Dementia
abstract: We study whether long-term cumulative exposure to airborne small particulate matter (PM₂.₅)affects the probability that an individual receives a new diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease or related dementias. We track the health, residential location, and PM₂.₅ exposures of Americans aged 65 and above from 2001 through 2013.The expansion of Clean Air Act regulations led to quasi-random variation in individuals' subsequent exposures to PM₂.₅.We leverage these regulations to construct instrumental variables for individual-level decadal PM₂.₅ that we use within flexible probit models that also account for any potential sample selection based on survival. We find that a 1 μg/m3 increase in decadal PM₂.₅ increases the probability of a new dementia diagnosis by an average of 2.15 percentage points. All else equal, we find larger effects for women, older people, and people with more clinical risk factors for dementia. These effects persist below current regulatory thresholds.
abstract_zh: 我们研究长期累积暴露于空气中的细颗粒物（PM₂.₅）是否会影响个体被新诊断为阿尔茨海默病或相关痴呆的概率。我们追踪了2001至2013年间65岁及以上美国人的健康状况、居住地点和PM₂.₅暴露情况。《清洁空气法》监管的扩展，导致了个体随后所暴露的PM₂.₅出现准随机变化。我们利用这些法规构建了个体层面十年期PM₂.₅的工具变量，并将其用于灵活的probit模型中，该模型还考虑了基于存活情况的潜在样本选择问题。我们发现，十年期PM₂.₅每增加1 μg/m³，新的痴呆诊断概率平均增加2.15个百分点。在其他条件相同的情况下，我们发现女性、高龄人群以及具有更多痴呆临床风险因素的人群，效应更大。这些效应即使在当前监管阈值以下依然存在。

title: New Evidence on Diversity in Environmental and Resource Economics
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: We describe new data on diversity within the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE), with a focus on association membership and publication in the association’s flagship journal, the Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (JAERE). We use these data to provide an update on the status of women in AERE and to extend the scope of diversity measures to describe the professional position, employer, alma mater, degree year, and degree country of JAERE authors. We find that AERE’s female membership share was approximately 29 percent in 2020. Compared with membership, women served in AERE leadership roles at higher rates and accounted for a smaller share of JAERE authors. In terms of international diversity, 72 percent of JAERE authors were employed in the United States, 78 percent of authors with PhDs earned their degrees from US schools, and 15 percent of authors obtained undergraduate degrees from schools outside the United States, Canada, and the European Union. We also show that 25 percent of JAERE authors were affiliated with 10 employers and 40 percent of authors obtained their highest degrees from 10 schools.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了环境与资源经济学家协会（AERE）内部多样性的新数据，重点关注协会会员身份以及在协会旗舰期刊《环境与资源经济学家协会期刊》（JAERE）上发表论文的情况。我们利用这些数据更新了AERE中女性的现状，并扩展了多样性指标的范围，以描述JAERE作者的职业职位、所在雇主、母校、学位获取年份和学位获取国家。我们发现，2020年AERE的女性会员比例约为29%。与会员比例相比，女性在AERE领导职务中的比例更高，但在JAERE作者中所占比例较小。在国际多样性方面，72%的JAERE作者受雇于美国，78%拥有博士学位的作者的学位来自美国院校，15%的作者本科学位来自美国、加拿大和欧盟以外的院校。我们还发现，25%的JAERE作者隶属于10家雇主，40%的作者的最高学位来自10所院校。

Environmental Regulations and the Welfare Effects of Job Layoffs in the United States: A Spatial Approach
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article develops welfare-consistent measures of the employment effects of environmental regulation. Our analysis is based on a microeconomic model of how households with heterogeneous preferences and skills decide where to live and work. We use the model to examine how job loss and unemployment would affect workers in Northern California. Our stylized simulations produce earnings losses that are consistent with empirical evidence. They also produce two new insights. First, we find that earnings losses are sensitive to business cycle conditions. Second, we find that earnings losses may substantially understate welfare losses once we account for the fact that workers may have to commute further or live in a less desirable community after losing a job.
abstract_zh: 本文发展了与福利保持一致的环境规制就业效应度量方法。我们的分析基于一个微观经济模型，该模型刻画了具有异质偏好与技能的家庭如何决定居住和工作地点。我们利用该模型考察失业如何影响北加利福尼亚的工人。我们的程式化模拟得出了与经验证据相一致的收入损失。它们还得出了两项新的见解。首先，我们发现收入损失对经济周期状况较为敏感。其次，我们发现，若考虑到工人在失业后可能需要通勤更远距离或居住于条件较差的社区，收入损失可能大大低估福利损失。

Equilibrium Sorting Models of Land Use and Residential Choice
abstract: Equilibrium sorting models of household location choice provide a framework for understanding the interactions among people, markets, and spatially delineated amenities. Sorting models begin by characterizing the spatial landscape and household preferences. Utility-maximizing location choices are expressed as a function of the characteristics of people, houses, and communities, as well as of structural parameters describing latent preferences. This relationship is then inverted, using the logic of revealed preference to characterize the distribution of household preferences for amenities. Estimation results are used to calculate the willingness to pay for changes in landscape amenities and to predict how people and markets will adjust to counterfactual policies. This chapter aims to make sorting models accessible to economists who are new to the literature and to clarify their connection to the reduced form models of hedonic equilibria that have traditionally been used for “back of the envelope” policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 家庭居住地选择的均衡分类模型提供了一个框架，用以理解人口、市场与空间界定的舒适性（amenities）之间的相互作用。分类模型首先刻画空间景观和家庭偏好。效用最大化的位置选择被表示为人的特征、住房与社区特征，以及描述潜在偏好的结构参数的函数。随后利用显示性偏好的逻辑对该关系进行反演，以刻画家庭对舒适性偏好的分布。估计结果用于计算景观舒适性变化的支付意愿，并预测人口与市场将如何对反事实政策做出调整。本章旨在使刚接触该文献的经济学者能够理解分类模型，并阐明其与传统上用于“信封背面”式政策分析的享乐均衡简化式模型之间的联系。

Are Travelers Willing to Pay a Premium to Stay at a "Green" Hotel? Evidence from an Internal Meta-Analysis of Hedonic Price Premia
abstract: A growing number of hotels provide “green” lodging for travelers with strong environmental preferences. Twelve states have developed certification programs to regulate these claims. After describing the new market for green lodging, we use data on prices and amenities of “green” and “brown” hotels in Virginia to estimate a hedonic model of hotel room pricing. We find that travelers can expect to pay a significant premium for a standard room in a green hotel. An internal meta-analysis is used to evaluate the robustness of this result to subjective econometric modeling decisions. Our results indicate a premium between $9 and $26.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的酒店为具有强烈环保偏好的旅客提供“绿色”住宿。十二个州已制定认证计划来规范这些宣称。在描述绿色住宿这一新市场之后，我们利用弗吉尼亚州“绿色”与“棕色”酒店的价格和设施数据，估计了酒店客房定价的享乐模型。我们发现，旅客在绿色酒店入住标准间时可预期支付显著的溢价。我们采用内部元分析来评估这一结果对主观计量建模决策的稳健性。结果表明，溢价在9美元至26美元之间。

title: Why Isn't More U.S. Farmland Organic?
abstract: We develop a theoretical model to assess the dollar compensation required to induce conventional growers to convert to organic. The model incorporates the uncertainty in producers’ expectations about future returns and about the impact of policy changes on these expectations in particular. We demonstrate that a new policy which favours organic can have opposing effects on the rate of conversion. An increase in relative returns to organic today will increase conversion rates. However, if the future of the policy programme is uncertain, its introduction can increase the value of waiting to switch, which will decrease conversion rates. We then develop an empirical switching regression model that enables direct estimation of the value associated with being able to postpone the conversion decision until some of the uncertainty is resolved. The model is applied to data on organic and conventional soybeans before and after major changes in US farm policy toward organic growers. The results suggest that sunk costs associated with conversion to organic coupled with uncertainty about future returns can help to explain why there is so little organic farmland in the USA.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个理论模型，用于评估促使常规种植者转为有机种植所需的货币补偿。该模型纳入了生产者对未来收益以及政策变化对这些预期（尤其是）影响的不确定性。我们证明，有利于有机农业的新政策可能对转换率产生相反的效应。当前有机收益相对提高会提升转换率。然而，如果政策计划的未来不确定，其出台可能会提高等待转换的价值，从而降低转换率。随后，我们构建了一个实证转换回归模型，使我们能够直接估计，在推迟转换决策直至部分不确定性得到解决时所具有的价值。该模型应用于美国农业政策对有机种植者作出重大调整前后的有机大豆与常规大豆数据。结果表明，与转为有机相关的沉没成本，加上对未来收益的不确定性，有助于解释为何美国的有机农田如此稀少。
